result.content: # 文生图 ## 01 功能介绍 将文字创意快速转化为图像，用于概念探索、风格确定和 3D 制作参考。 ## 02 操作流程 Step1：输入prompt Step2：选择基础模型和图像尺寸 Step3：点击生成 ## 03 演示视频 # 局部重绘 ## 01 功能介绍 对图像的指定区域进行局部修改与细化，在不影响整体风格的前提下，快速调整细节、修正结构或替换局部内容。 ## 02 操作流程 Step1：选择图片，右下角点击「局部重绘」按钮 Step2：在画布上涂抹想要修改的区域 Step3：输入编辑指令 Step4：点击生成 ## 03 演示视频 # 图生智能参考 ## 01 功能介绍 基于上传的图像自动优化提示词，生成结构更清晰、更适合 3D 建模的参考图像。 ## 02 操作流程 Step1：上传一张图片 Step2：输入提示词 > 推荐使用【提示词优化】和【3D生成参考图】，自动优化提示词，生成更适合3D建模的参考图 Step3：选择基础模型和图像尺寸 Step4：点击生成 ## 03 演示视频
result.contentEn: # Text-to-Image ## 01 Feature Overview Quickly turn text-based ideas into images for concept exploration, style definition, and 3D creation reference. ## 02 Steps Step 1: Enter your prompt Step 2: Select a base model and image size Step 3: Click Generate to create your image. ## 03 Demo Video # Inpainting ## 01 Feature Overview Edit and refine specific areas of an image without affecting the overall style—ideal for adjusting details, fixing structures, or replacing local elements. ## 02 Steps Step 1: Select an image and find Local Repaint in the bottom-right corner Step 2: Paint over the area you want to modify Step 3: Enter editing instructions Step 4: Click Generate ## 03 Demo Video # Image-based Smart Reference ## 01 Feature Overview Automatically refines prompts based on the uploaded image to generate reference images with clearer structure, optimized for 3D modeling. ## 02 Steps Step 1: Upload an image Step 2: Enter a prompt to help convert your image into a clear reference suitable for 3D modeling Step 3: Select a base model and image size Step 4: Click Generate ## 03 Demo Video
result.keyword: V2Fun AI image guide, text to image, AI image generation, inpainting, local repaint, image reference, 3D modeling reference image
